newsitem.title: ITALY: IMI won't take part in BankNapoli offer.
newsitem.headline: IMI won't take part in BankNapoli offer.

text.p: Italian bank Istituto Mobiliare Italiano (IMI) does not intend to take part in bidding for the privatisation of loss-making Banco di Napoli, IMI director-general Rainer Masera said.
"The question has not been brought to the attention of the board and therefore I say no," he said in reply to a question from reporters while attending a function at the Milan bourse.

A rescue plan for the troubled bank, which chalked up the biggest losses in Italian banking history last year, includes a two trillion lire cash injection by the Italian Treasury and an eventual privatisation planned by the end of this year.
